notes: Use it after changing anything about the volume keys G2, G3 and G4 or about remapping. Before you start, in Mapping: G3 → RB, leave G4 as it is (Mute, built in), G2 → Nothing. Also set the Mac's sound output to about half volume and not muted (not at the very bottom or top, or a step cannot tell and says so), and leave the sound output alone while it runs. Afterwards: Mapping → Reset all remaps. G3 must send RB to the pad and leave the Mac's volume alone; G4 must still mute and then unmute the Mac (two separate steps); G2 must send nothing to the pad and leave the volume alone. The volume is judged from what the Mac's sound output does while the controller reports the key press, so a key that is silenced still has to be pressed to count; a step that cannot tell (no key press seen, the output has no volume or mute, the volume already at its limit, the output changed) shows as inconclusive, not as a pass. The pad side is written out in the template on purpose, so it does not check the mapper against itself. Runs on the App path and then on Driver LIVE.

steps.detail: Put the controller down and let go of every stick, trigger and button. The pad has to stay completely still.
steps.title: Hands off everything

steps.detail: Press G3, let go, press it again, let go. G3 now sends RB: the pad must show RB, and the Mac's volume must not move.
steps.title: Press G3 twice

steps.detail: Press G4 once and let go. It still does its own job: the Mac's sound should switch off (mute).
steps.title: Press G4 once

steps.detail: Press G4 once more and let go. The Mac's sound should come back on (unmute).
steps.title: Press G4 once more

steps.detail: Press G2, let go, press it again, let go. G2 now sends Nothing: the pad must stay quiet and the Mac's volume must not move.
steps.title: Press G2 twice

title: Volume keys under a remap: G2, G3, G4 (App, then Driver)
